name: Oc nui nuong
summary: Grilled mountain snail. DulichToday lists nướng among ways to cook ốc núi in the Tam Coc eating section, and says the snail lives in rock caves and comes out in the rains from April to August. No dipping sauce is named. A clock hour is Check on arrival.
